column1: # The kind node images the kind job runs, one row per leg (scripts/kind-up.sh --node <leg>; CI runs
# every leg). The one place both are pinned. Columns (tab-separated): leg  kubectl-pin  image
# Both come from the "Images pre-built for this release" list of the pinned kind (mise.toml,
# kind), by digest (kind supports only those digests): floor is the oldest minor listed and is the
# chart's kubeVersion floor (Chart.yaml); newest is kind's default node image. kubectl-pin names
# the mise.toml entry of a kubectl within one minor of that node (the version-skew policy).
# Move all three with the kind pin; tests/supply_chain/test_kind_nodes.py keeps them consistent.
